newsitem.title: JAPAN: NAMCO to unveil Nikkatsu restructuring plan Friday.
newsitem.headline: NAMCO to unveil Nikkatsu restructuring plan Friday.

text.p: Game equipment maker NAMCO Ltd will announce a restructuring programme for financially troubled movie maker Nikkatsu Corp on Friday, a NAMCO spokesman said on Thursday.
NAMCO president Masaya Nakamura will hold a news conference at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) on Friday to unveil the plan, he said.

In July 1993, Nikkatsu filed for protection from creditors under the Corporate Reorganisation and Rehabilitation Act. Nikkatsu and its six group companies had total outstanding debt of 60 billion yen. In the same year, NAMCO said it would bail out the movie maker.
The NAMCO spokesman said the company had initially planned to have one of its units support Nikkatsu, but that it now plans to help Nikkatsu through the parent company itself.
NAMCO's Nakamura said in 1993 that his company was planning to use Nikkatsu's movie-making technology for the development of its multimedia software.
